verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a local LLM inference engine, so a pre-download model-fit recommender is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence only shows that models download directly via -hf, that quantization exists, and that community users report hardware performance themselves. Nothing documents an AI assistant or tool that recommends a model for a user's hardware and task before download.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
